premises.text: Farm software built by a grower for growers is the right product design
premises.evidence_span: it was built by a grower for growers, by a farmer for farmers

premises.text: Farms must track worker location and activity to stay compliant with H-2A and labor laws
premises.evidence_span: farmers do this not just to better understand their farms, but to be compliant with labor laws

premises.text: Most farms still track labor with pen and paper, which makes compliance impractical
premises.evidence_span: 84% of farms today are still tracking everything with pen and paper

premises.text: A multi-app stack digitizes labor who-what-when-where data with dashboard, field tablet/NFC, and geotagged phone clock-in
premises.evidence_span: AgriTrack captures the most vital data that farmers need, which is labor

premises.text: A labor audit report packages Department of Labor-ready documentation for farm audits
premises.evidence_span: it has everything that's in step with the Department of Labor and what they need if they come and audit a farm

premises.text: The system accurately calculates complex hour, piece-rate, and overtime payroll so farms stay compliant
premises.evidence_span: we handle all that for them, so that they know that when they do payroll, it's accurate

value.text: Farms gain accurate digitized labor data and confidence they can pass Department of Labor audits
value.evidence_span: farms can utilize AgriTrack to have confidence in the data that they're collecting, knowing that it's accurate, and that if the Department of Labor comes knocking, they feel okay

secondary_value.text: Payroll that used to take a day or more can be completed in minutes
secondary_value.evidence_span: what used to take a day or more to run payroll and do that process is now actually being done in minutes with AgriTrack
